USER MANUAL  
Web-Based Visual Schedule and Task Management System

1\. Introduction	  
Welcome to Web-Based Visual Schedule and Task Management System. This project aims to build web-based visual schedule and task management system helping children with developmental delays

2\. Downloading the Project File

- Open the Github link in your browser ([https\://github.com/Wackiniii/visual-schedule-and-task-management-system](https://github.com/Wackiniii/visual-schedule-and-task-management-system))   
- Click the **Code** button and select **Download Zip**  
- Select the destination of the zip file in your computer  
- Extract the zip file by right click and select **Extract All..**, extracting the zip file.

3\. First Time Of Setting Up Database (For New Users)

- Open XAMPP control panel then start both Apache and MySQL  
- Click Admin button next to MySQL module that will redirect you to phpmyadmin http\://localhost/phpmyadmin  
- Click SQL tab on top of the page  
- Copy the schema from database/schema.sql, paste it into the SQL query box then click Go (or import the file schema.sql)

4\. Launching the Website

- Open the project folder and double click the **start.bat** file.  
- Wait for the system to start and launch the website automatically in your browser  
- When finished, ensure to double click the **stop.bat** file that terminates the server running on your computer.

![][image1]  
	Figure 1: Login Interface

5\. User Guide  
5.1 Creating and Logging an Account

- When you don’t have an account yet, click Create an Account to register  
- Fill the necessary fields that include your name, email address, etc.  
- Click Create Account once finished and log in using the registered email address.

5.2 Managing the Child Profile

- Click Add Child button  
- Fill the necessary fields of the child  
- You may choose to paste an image address link to the photo url to upload the child’s avatar photo.  
- Make sure to press the Save button saving the information entered.  
- Use the Edit or Delete button to modify or delete child profiles in your dashboard.

![][image2]  
	Figure 2: Dashboard Interface  
5.3 Building Daily Visual Schedule

- From the Dashboard page, select Schedule Builder.  
- You can choose different child profile and select target date for the routine  
- You can drag and drop different task cards shown in the left side or create custom tasks then drag and drop to New Tasks.  
- Set the time and duration near the task.  
- Ensure that you click the Save New Tasks button before proceeding to other tabs.

	![][image3]  
	Figure 3: Schedule Builder Interface  
5.4 Monitoring Progress and Accessibility Settings

- Progress Tab: This can be used to track the progress of the child and see the task accomplished and their overall progress.  
- Settings Tab: This can be used to customize your own interface that can help the children also in using it (text size, contrast mode..)

6\. Child Guide  
When the schedule is ready, click Child View button that will be used by the child  
6.1 Visual Schedule and Timer

- The set tasks should appear with a large icon and clear label.  
- Tap the start timer which will start the countdown, by this, the child will see how much is left before the next task will begin.  
- When finished, the child or the user can tap the large green button signifying that the task is finished. Upon completion, an audio cue will play and will proceed to the next task.

![][image4]  
6.2 My Talking Board

- Below the Timer, My Talking Board can be seen  
- The child can press different buttons that will play the audio of the word with the use of text-to-speech feature, so that the child can communicate their needs more efficiently.

	![][image5]  
7\. FAQs

| Issue | Solution |
| :---- | :---- |
| Database Failed:  | Make sure that you verify first the database ensuring that it exists. |
| Unable to Connect | Ensure to launch the application with start.bat and wait for several seconds before refreshing the page. |
| Tasks or profile won’t save | Ensure that the MySQL is running properly and the schema is imported on the database. (Refer to No. 3\) |
